purpose: Compare the running image decoder source with the staged RX fix image on the same saved resilient-50 HF capture.
method: One-shot Docker containers, network disabled, identical read-only audio/metadata mounts, existing container_resilient_replay.py diagnostic; no audio device, PTT, or live container interaction.
interpretation: The candidate image fixes this saved resilient-50 capture: all 10 protected blocks and whole-card checks pass, with exact expected pixels. This does not establish on-air success. The running container remains on the older image until an approved recreate/cutover.
